MARATHON WAREHOUSE DISTRIBUTION is a Motor Vehicle Manufacturing company. Marathon Warehouse Distribution is an independent national wholesale distributor that provides motor factors and accessory shops with a fast, frequent same day delivery service to areas covering 85% of the UK's population, as well as a next day parcel service to factors not currently within the expanding same day service areas. # Marathon Distributors Ltd

Marathon Distributors Ltd is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Marathon Distributors is a key link in the pharmaceutical and healthcare supply chain. They take every measure to ensure that healthcare products reach those who need them, when and how they need them. Marathon Distributors Ltd employs 11 people and has an annual revenue of $90.7K. Headquartered in Latsia, Nicosia, Cyprus, with presence in United States.

## About

Marathon Distributors is Cyprus’ leading healthcare logistics provider with a 35% market share, offering services along the supply chain such as warehousing, call centre, transportation, collections and repackaging. We deliver to all pharmacies, hospitals, doctors and analysts across Cyprus using our own specialized vehicles. 

We handle a wide range of products including prescription medicines, vaccines, OTC, vitamins and supplements, cosmetics and others. Our customer database includes international companies such as GlaxoSmithKline, AstraZeneca, MSD, Merck Serono, L’Oreal and Unilever.
